entries:
Alpha 1.9.16 (hit like a landslide)

  • Charge lands twice as hard: The Fighter's base right-click Charge now deals double its previous impact damage in multiplayer and offline play.
  • The rest of the kit keeps its identity: Momentum still scales from the stronger base hit, while Shattering Charge, Juggernaut Charge, Shockwave knockback, range, cooldown, and mana cost are unchanged.

Alpha 1.9.15 (trusted hands)

  • Administration has a safe foundation: Approved accounts can now activate a durable administrator role without changing character level, equipment, or progression.
  • Authority stays server-owned: Administrator status follows the authenticated account, remains separate from release-QA access, and is persisted before success is reported.

Alpha 1.9.14 (defend the artificer)

  • Maelin is your ally: Combat targeting no longer mistakes the crystal-repair artificer for an enemy while she channels the Vigil. Focus your attacks on the invading wave instead.
  • The Vigil stays intact: Maelin still begins her ritual automatically. All three repair waves, their objectives, and manual quest rewards are unchanged.

Alpha 1.9.13 (return to your hand)

  • Walk back without an instant fold: After a server restart, poker now preserves its existing reconnect grace while you return to your chair, including walking upstairs through the VIP guard. Logging in no longer folds your funded hand before you can sit down.
  • The same fair rules: Turn timers still run, the original reconnect deadline is unchanged, and deliberately leaving still folds your hand. EP wagers and winnings stay in EP; Gold balances and monthly allowances are unchanged.

Alpha 1.9.12 (the whole table in view)

  • Keep the dealer and all six seats in view: Blackjack and poker now separate the table from scrolling wager controls. Choosing an action no longer scrolls the dealer and upper seats out of sight.
  • Readable hands on smaller screens: Compact portrait and landscape layouts keep hand totals visible. Long names and result captions no longer crowd out the cards; their full text remains available on hover. Win panels stay clear of the timer, and community cards fit their board.
  • Your game rules stay the same: Blackjack still pays 3:2 on naturals. Gold and EP remain separate, and wagering, payouts, saved balances and quest progression are unchanged.

Alpha 1.9.11 (quests alongside your party)

  • Keep your quests in sight: Joining a party no longer hides your tracked quests. A compact scrolling strip keeps every selected quest reachable above the party roster, without covering healing controls.
  • Clean, accessible tracking: Rows snap into view with progress counts and full text on hover. Keyboard scrolling stays with the tracker instead of triggering a cast, and the Journal shortcut still lets you choose what to track. Solo quest cards and phone navigation are unchanged.

Alpha 1.9.10 (finding the next chapter)

  • Clearer raid and portal guidance: Locked entries now show the required Chronicle quest names instead of outdated chapter numbers, and explain when to turn in your quest to Archmage Ilyra after clearing a dungeon or restoring the crystals.
  • Your progress stays yours: Entry levels, unlock requirements, rewards and saved progress are unchanged. Quest completion still requires your manual turn-in.

Alpha 1.9.9 (room for more adventurers)

  • Crowded-area performance: Reduced repeated server memory allocations when many players see the same characters, enemies and effects, helping crowded areas stay responsive. Combat rules, viewing distances and update frequency are unchanged.
  • Fresh, isolated updates: Shared actor updates are rebuilt every broadcast. Equipment changes, effects and departing players stay current, while instance boundaries and private inventory, EP receipts and cosmetic ownership remain protected.

Alpha 1.9.8 (protecting your progress)

  • EP progress protection: Incompatible older servers are now blocked from loading saves that contain EP balances, VIP allowances, casino receipts and cosmetic ownership. Existing balances, rewards and purchases stay unchanged.
  • Safer upgrades: This save-format upgrade takes a consistent recovery backup before admitting the new server, including membership records, pending wagers and private save journals. A failed backup keeps the prior server available.

Alpha 1.9.7 (the Sovereign Lounge)

  • Upstairs is open to VIP members: Talk to the casino guard and choose Enter VIP lounge. Walk the upper balcony and galleries, sit at the Crownless Court blackjack table or the Sovereigns’ Covenant poker table, or play four elemental EP machines. Return downstairs at the stair landing. The public floor remains Gold-only.
  • EP tables, EP winnings: Blackjack accepts 2–100 EP in steps of 2 and pays exact 3:2 profit on naturals. Hold’em accepts 10–100 EP buy-ins in steps of 10, with 1/2 EP blinds and at least two real players. Slots accept 10–100 EP in steps of 10, keeping all ten payline stakes whole. Each game shows its actual EP wallet balance, stake controls and winnings.
  • A shared upstairs experience: VIP card tables have independent shared hands, seats, timers and pots, separate from public tables. Seated camera views, visible players, hand counts, win celebrations, animated slots and auto-spin controls work upstairs too. Upper-floor collision and seat exits use the real balcony height.
  • Saved without crossing currencies: EP wagers and returns have their own durable receipts. Retry and restart recovery cannot charge or pay twice, and an empty EP wallet never spends Gold. Already-funded hands settle even after membership expires or a player disconnects; saved slot features remain attached to their owner.
  • Cosmetics, not power: Trusted membership is required for upstairs entry and new EP funding. EP ownership alone is not VIP access. EP cannot be exchanged for Gold, transferred to another player or used for combat power. No checkout, billing, real-money purchase flow or production membership grants are added.
